# TPC-DS-OBT Q78

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ws AS (SELECT obt.sold_date_d_year AS ws_sold_year, obt.item_sk, obt.bill_customer_sk AS ws_customer_sk, SUM(obt.quantity) AS ws_qty, SUM(obt.wholesale_cost) AS ws_wc, SUM(obt.sales_price) AS ws_sp FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE ((obt.sale_id IS NULL AND (obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk)) AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk) AND channel = 'web' GROUP BY obt.sold_date_d_year, obt.item_sk, obt.bill_customer_sk), cs AS (SELECT obt.sold_date_d_year AS cs_sold_year, obt.item_sk, obt.bill_customer_sk AS cs_customer_sk, SUM(obt.quantity) AS cs_qty, SUM(obt.wholesale_cost) AS cs_wc, SUM(obt.sales_price) AS cs_sp FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE ((obt.sale_id IS NULL AND (obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk)) AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk) AND channel = 'catalog' GROUP BY obt.sold_date_d_year, obt.item_sk, obt.bill_customer_sk), ss AS (SELECT obt.sold_date_d_year AS ss_sold_year, obt.item_sk, obt.ship_customer_sk, SUM(obt.quantity) AS ss_qty, SUM(obt.wholesale_cost) AS ss_wc, SUM(obt.sales_price) AS ss_sp FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE ((obt.sale_id IS NULL AND (obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk)) AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.sold_date_d_year, obt.item_sk, obt.ship_customer_sk) SELECT ss_sold_year, ROUND(CAST(ss_qty AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cs_qty, 0)), 0), 2) AS ratio, ss_qty AS store_qty, ss_wc AS store_wholesale_cost, ss_sp AS store_sales_price, COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cs_qty, 0) AS other_chan_qty, COALESCE(ws_wc, 0) + COALESCE(cs_wc, 0) AS other_chan_wholesale_cost, COALESCE(ws_sp, 0) + COALESCE(cs_sp, 0) AS other_chan_sales_price FROM ss LEFT JOIN ws ON (ws_sold_year = ss_sold_year AND ws.item_sk = ss.item_sk AND ws_customer_sk = ship_customer_sk) LEFT JOIN cs ON (cs_sold_year = ss_sold_year AND ss.item_sk = cs.item_sk AND cs_customer_sk = ship_customer_sk) WHERE (((COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(cs_qty, 0) > 0) AND ss_sold_year = 1998) AND (ws_sold_year = ss_sold_year AND ws.item_sk = ss.item_sk AND ws_customer_sk = ship_customer_sk)) AND (cs_sold_year = ss_sold_year AND ss.item_sk = cs.item_sk AND cs_customer_sk = ship_customer_sk) ORDER BY ss_sold_year, ss_qty DESC, ss_wc DESC, ss_sp DESC, other_chan_qty, other_chan_wholesale_cost, other_chan_sales_price, ratio LIMIT 100
```
